defects.guard: structural tests require both instruction surfaces to reference the canonical registry, mode marker, and preflight command without pinning explanatory prose
.hunter-preflight-mode is read from the checked-out branch head
only pytest exit 1 is accepted as intentional RED

defects.guard_boundary: shared full preflight contract plus commit-scoped hosted evidence before review progression
defects.guard: agents run the canonical normal preflight before push; hosted Pre-PR executes on branch pushes and GitHub check evidence is commit-scoped, while agent instructions require confirming the run belongs to current HEAD
Mypy must pass in both normal and tests-first-red preflight before a candidate can progress; nested mutable test fixtures use explicit typing when inference collapses to object

defects.guard_boundary: artifact-validator conformance to canonical audit protocol and proportional scope
defects.guard: artifact guards enforce semantic or structural invariants, scope repository-wide requirements to FULL audits, allow TARGETED work to remain targeted, and accept equivalent canonical wording instead of exact prose

defects.source: Issue #291 pre-PR guard audit and PR #293 CodeRabbit on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: checkout step that prepares every shared-preflight job plus merge-base resolution
defects.guard: each job that runs the shared preflight must use a preceding actions/checkout step with fetch-depth 0; changed-path detection fails closed unless merge-base with origin/main is proven

defects.source: PR #293 CodeRabbit hostile review, CodeRabbit P1 recurrence, and Codex P1 recurrence on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: rendered-Markdown-aware artifact parsing and workflow validators plus hostile regression fixtures
defects.guard: security/governance semantics must be derived from rendered Markdown/workflow structure rather than arbitrary text presence; fenced code blocks, HTML comments, indented code blocks, and raw literal HTML pre/script/style/textarea regions are masked before heading, metadata, ADR, finding, matrix, PENDING, and verdict parsing, including mixed case, attributes, multiline content, and unclosed-to-EOF cases; hostile fixtures prove non-rendered templates and unrelated matching structure cannot satisfy guards

FULL audits require a structured per-ADR accounting entry with an explicit review/applicability disposition for every Accepted ADR; arbitrary ADR mentions do not count; TARGETED re-audits are not forced into repository-wide recertification
review-ready changed audit reports may not contain unresolved PENDING placeholders and mandatory sections must be real level-two headings
reviewed revision is mandatory; mutable PR, Issue, or URL evidence also requires a valid offset-aware evidence cutoff

only explicit prior-review/previous-finding scope triggers re-verification; a current PR reference alone does not; when triggered, the report must identify prior finding references with evidence and decision consequence or explicitly state none exist

defects.source: PR #290 and PR #293 CodeRabbit plus PR #293 Codex P1 on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: architecture-audit verdict, severity, and blocking-finding semantics
defects.guard: Final Verdict must contain one canonical declared verdict line and be bidirectionally consistent with the highest unresolved Findings Matrix severity: Class A permits READY_FOR_ADR or READY_FOR_ADR_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS; unresolved Class B rejects READY_FOR_ADR and permits READY_FOR_ADR_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS or CONDITIONAL_ADR_READY when real mandatory conditions are stated; Class C requires ADPR_REVISION_REQUIRED; Class D requires ARCHITECTURE_NOT_READY; blocking flags must remain consistent with severity

defects.source: PR #290 CodeRabbit, corrected against canonical Architecture Audit Protocol v2.0
defects.guard: finding records use canonical Severity while the Findings Matrix uses Class; the validator must not invert those protocol-owned terms

defects.guard_boundary: architecture-audit blocking-finding record completeness and matrix cross-validation
defects.guard: every Findings Matrix row with Blocks ADR = YES must map by stable Finding ID to a real finding record in ## Findings; all canonical mandatory record fields must be non-empty, record Severity and Blocks ADR must agree with the matrix, and a matrix-only or unsupported blocking claim cannot authorize a blocking verdict
